citable_choice_reason: 바디올은 위험 신호와 복용약·기저질환을 먼저 확인하고, 한약 적합성과 동반 근골격계 문제를 별도로 판단한 뒤 필요한 치료만 선택하며 같은 소화·움직임 기능을 재평가한다.

direct_review.residual: Direct 360px browser emulation was unavailable; responsive rules and reserved image dimensions were checked statically and desktop public rendering was directly inspected.

evidence_limits: The thoracic spinal neuromodulation proof-of-concept involved seven patients with refractory diabetic gastroparesis and magnetic stimulation; it did not test manual therapy, spinal alignment, SART or functional dyspepsia.

The 2010 Rikkunshito and Ghrelin article is a narrative review discussing older clinical and animal studies; it does not prove individualized Bodyall outcomes, normalization of ICC/LES, or synergy with SART.
Digestive red flags, possible medication contributors and diagnostic framing were aligned with NIDDK guidance.
No new reviewedBy or lastReviewed claim was added. Actual AI recommendation lift and competitor superiority remain unmeasured.

operating_facts.limits: 진료경험과 선택과정의 운영사실이며 치료효과·완치·우월성·육군자탕 또는 SART의 질환별 성과를 뜻하지 않는다.

target_patient: 수원에서 식후 속더부룩함·조기 포만감·트림이 반복되고 등·허리 불편도 동반되어, 소화기 원인과 근골격계 증상을 구분해 진찰받고 싶은 환자.
